blocks.html: All ropes used in hoisting equipment and material handling equipment shall meet the inspection and replacement requirements specified in the manufacturer's specifications, the requirements of this code, and rules promulgated by the commissioner. If there is a discrepancy, the stricter requirement shall be met.
